column1: # topic: Beowulf Part 2 (Another Attack to Another Celebration at Heorot)

column2: Grendel's mother is a monstrous water-hag descended from Cain who lives in the mere and attacks Heorot to avenge her son.
Aeschere was Hrothgar's most trusted counselor and battle companion, whom Grendel's mother carried off and killed.
Unferth, once Beowulf's mocker, lends him the sword Hrunting but loses fame because he dares not fight underwater himself.
